title: '22 built-in agents' count and list is obsolete
reality: v2.3.0 moved nearly every former built-in into optional downloadable packages and removed 25,000+ lines of agent/map/call/table-game code from the base Engine ('Reduced the base Engine...', 2.3.0 Changed). The Marinara-Agents README confirms 21 of the doc's 22 listed built-ins are now catalog packages: director, knowledge-retrieval, knowledge-router, html, echo-chamber, combat, prose-guardian, continuity, world-state, character-tracker, custom-tracker, persona-stats, quest, expression, background, illustrator, lorebook-keeper, card-evolution-auditor, spotify (Music DJ), cyoa, haptic. Only Conversation's About Me profile / update_about_me tool remain built into the Engine ('are not agents and must not be published in this catalog'). Fresh installs contain NO optional agents.
fix: Rewrite the 'Built-In Agents' section of references/agents.md as 'Official downloadable agents (formerly built-ins)': drop the '22 built-in agents' claim and the BUILT_IN_AGENT_MANIFESTS counting instruction; keep the per-agent descriptions but state each is an optional package installed via Agents -> Download Agents; note fresh installs ship with zero optional agents and that About Me / update_about_me stays Engine-native.

title: Download Agents library not documented
reality: v2.3.0 added a responsive full-page Agents -> Download Agents library for installing, reading about, updating, and uninstalling official capability packages, grouped installed/uninstalled and ordered Writer, Tracker, Misc Agents, with creator artwork and an Agents-star fallback; desktop opens it beside the sidebar, mobile full-screen. Route-bearing packages take a safe restart path while Conversation games activate without restart (2.3.2 #3699). 2.3.0 also added Install All / Uninstall All beneath the search box, run through a safe sequential queue with progress, partial-failure reporting, and a confirmation before removing every installed agent. Empty Chat Settings -> Agents states and setup wizards link directly to Download Agents.
fix: Add a new top-level section 'Download Agents library (v2.3)' to references/agents.md describing the install/update/uninstall flow, Writer/Tracker/Misc groupings, Install All / Uninstall All, restart-when-asked behavior, and that empty agent sections link to Download Agents.

title: Marinara-Agents catalog repo and 29-package catalog missing
reality: v2.3.0 published first-party agents in github.com/Pasta-Devs/Marinara-Agents as individually verified packages (schema validation, SHA-256 archive checksum, per-file hash/size checks, atomic install into the Engine data dir, offline availability after install). The catalog currently holds 29 first-party packages: 6 Writer, 8 Tracker, 15 Misc. Professor Mari's prompts carry a canonical 29-package catalog summary (2.3.0 Changed). Package IDs match the old built-in ids (e.g. spotify = Music DJ, conversation-calls = Calls). The Engine's canonical agent doc is now docs/agents/built-in-agents.md ('Downloadable Agents Reference').
fix: Add a 'Package catalog' subsection to references/agents.md: name the Pasta-Devs/Marinara-Agents repo, the 29-package / 6-8-15 breakdown, the verification/atomic-install trust model, and link the Engine's Downloadable Agents Reference; map old built-in ids to their package ids.

title: New packages absent: Hierarchical Maps, Calls, six table games
reality: v2.3.0 moved Hierarchical Maps, Conversation audio/video calls, UNO, Chess, Poker, 8-Ball Pool, Tic-Tac-Toe, and Rock-Paper-Scissors into optional packages with package-owned server runtimes. Hierarchical Maps is a Tracker Agent enableable in Roleplay and during/after Game creation, its controls live inside its entry in Chat Settings -> Agents (2.3.2 #3679), and it now obeys the per-chat Enable Agents toggle (2.3.3). Conversation Calls was renamed 'Calls' user-facing (2.3.2 #3676) and owns the Local Whisper model downloads (uninstalling removes downloaded Whisper models, 2.3.0). The six table games surface as Conversation command toggles (/uno, /chess, /poker, /8ball, /tictactoe, /rps), not per-chat pipeline agents (2.3.0 Fixed).
fix: Add entries for hierarchical-maps (Tracker), conversation-calls/'Calls' (Misc), and the six Conversation game packages to the agent list in references/agents.md, noting the games are command/surface packages rather than pipeline agents and that Calls owns Local Whisper downloads.

title: Startup auto-upgrade and offline behavior of installed packages undocumented
reality: v2.3.1: installed official agents and feature packages check the Marinara-Agents catalog during server startup and automatically upgrade to the newest compatible version before their runtimes activate; offline, incompatible, missing, or failed package updates leave the previously installed version available, and verified server-runtime failures continue to roll back automatically. 2.3.2 #3706/#3707: catalog HTTP failures now report real status/error and installed agents remain usable offline. 2.3.2 #3647 / 2.3.3: incompatible installed package versions (e.g. Hierarchical Maps 1.0.x) are quarantined before their hooks can crash generation.
fix: Add a 'Package lifecycle' note to references/agents.md covering startup auto-upgrade, offline fallback to the installed version, automatic rollback on runtime failure, and quarantine of incompatible package versions.

title: Per-major catalog lanes missing
reality: 2.3.3 #3712 added compatibility-aware catalog selection: each Engine major installs and updates only from its matching catalog lane. The Marinara-Agents repo publishes catalog/v2/catalog.json for Engine 2, catalog/v3/catalog.json for Engine 3, with catalog/catalog.json as the legacy Engine 2 alias.
fix: In the new package-catalog section of references/agents.md, document the per-major lanes (catalog/v2 vs catalog/v3) and that an Engine only sees packages compatible with its major version.

title: Capability API 1.3 host services undocumented
reality: 2.3.2 #3690 added capability API 1.3 host services for downloadable packages, including safe model routing, persistence, history/checkpoints, resources, logging, transactions, client contribution loading, and visible readiness/retry states. The base Engine now exposes 'small validated capability registries and compatibility bridges' while packages supply feature code (2.3.0 Changed). This is the extension surface a skill user building or debugging a package needs.
fix: Add a short 'Capability API (packages)' subsection to references/agents.md listing the 1.3 host services and noting that package server runtimes run with declared permissions and may require a restart when the runtime changes.

title: Enable Agents master toggle semantics missing
reality: Each chat has an 'Enable Agents' master switch that gates whether selected agents initialize or make model calls at all. The v2.3 capability migration explicitly preserves it so upgrading cannot silently reactivate agents (2.3.0 #3669), and 2.3.3 made Hierarchical Maps obey it across Roleplay/Game UI, prompt generation, retries, tracker patches, session carryover, and checkpoints. agents.md only says agents are 'disabled by default' with no mention of the per-chat master toggle.
fix: Document the per-chat Enable Agents master toggle in references/agents.md (e.g. in 'Tuning and Pitfalls' or the UI section): when it is off, no selected agent — including Hierarchical Maps — initializes or calls a model in that chat.

title: Custom-agent mode gating is stale
reality: 2.3.2 #3692: selected custom agents now run in Conversation, Roleplay, AND Game chats whenever Enable Agents is on; per-mode availability rules apply only to official packages. Download Agents also shows Conversation/Roleplay/Game compatibility badges and supports catalog search by supported mode (2.3.2 #3676). agents.md's 'Game Mode & mode gating' section still frames availability via the v2.0 modeAllowlist on built-ins and a Game-Mode-only custom-agent picker.
fix: Update the 'Game Mode & mode gating' section of references/agents.md: custom agents are mode-universal when Enable Agents is on (v2.3.2 #3692); official packages keep per-mode rules, surfaced as compatibility badges and mode search in Download Agents.

title: Install-gated commands and settings for Illustrator/Music DJ/etc. undocumented
reality: In v2.3.x, agent sections, settings, and package-owned command toggles appear only for installed agents (2.3.0 Changed). /illustrate and /selfie commands, image/video generation settings, and all Gallery generation actions (Illustrate, Selfie, Storyboard, Video, Animate, Background) require the Illustrator package installed and enabled per chat; the Connections 'Illustrator' defaults category was renamed 'Images'; selfie configuration is now 'Illustrator Settings' under Chat Settings -> Agents. The always-available Music Player toggle shows 'Download Music DJ Agent to configure' guidance when Music DJ is not installed. Game setup shows Hierarchical Maps, Music DJ, Lorebook Keeper, and Illustrator controls only when installed (all 2.3.0 Fixed/Changed).
fix: In the illustrator and spotify entries of references/agents.md (and a general note), state that these are install-gated: their commands, settings sections, and Gallery/Game-setup controls only appear once the package is installed, and name the renames (Illustrator Settings, Images defaults category).

title: Source-of-truth file paths likely stale after package split
reality: 2.3.0 removed 25,000+ lines of optional agent, map, call, and table-game implementation from the base Engine; feature code now lives in the Marinara-Agents repo (e.g. packages/hierarchical-maps/src/engine/), with the base exposing capability registries and bridges. agents.md's source-of-truth pointers (packages/server/src/services/agents/, agent-registry.generated.ts with BUILT_IN_AGENT_MANIFESTS counting, agent-prompts.ts as home of all built-in default prompts) predate this split and can no longer be trusted for the packaged agents.
fix: Update the 'Source of truth' line and prompt-template references in references/agents.md: point packaged-agent internals at the Pasta-Devs/Marinara-Agents repo and the Engine's docs/agents/built-in-agents.md reference, and flag that the base Engine now holds capability registries/bridges rather than agent implementations.

title: UI Location section outdated
reality: The Agents panel now lists installed downloadable packages (with downloaded catalog artwork applied, star fallback) plus the Download Agents entry point; uninstall updates the open sidebar immediately (2.3.0 Fixed). Chat Settings -> Agents stays available in Conversation, Roleplay, and Game even with no optional agents installed, with built-in Conversation commands configurable without downloads and empty Roleplay/Game sections linking to Download Agents (2.3.0 Fixed). The v2.3.2 catalog also reports real HTTP errors rather than blaming the internet (#3706, #3707).
fix: Rewrite the 'UI Location' section of references/agents.md to describe the installed-packages Agents panel, the Agents -> Download Agents entry point, and the always-available Chat Settings -> Agents with empty-state links to Download Agents.

title: Migration behavior for existing installs unmentioned
reality: Existing installations migrate their agents and chat feature selections to the package model without losing settings, runtime data, or history (2.3.0); the migration is restart-safe/idempotent (#3670) and preserves the Enable Agents switch (#3669). A 2.3.2 migration bug that auto-selected Hierarchical Maps in every Roleplay/VN/Game chat was corrected one-time in 2.3.3 (#3723). Users upgrading keep every feature that existed pre-split (Marinara-Agents README).
fix: Add a brief migration note to references/agents.md: upgrades from <=2.2 download the matching packages once and preserve chat selections/settings/history; mention the 2.3.3 one-time correction for the accidental Maps auto-selection so users are not confused by it.
